knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Each item needs its own specialist decision. A blanket request is refused.

practicalCriteria: For a fictional set of five items, the learner marks which need a specialist decision and holds each one out of use. Pass: each item is classified and held.
The learner writes a refusal note for a blanket salvage request. Pass: the note refers each item to the specialist path.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: A blanket salvage request is made.
